# FRONTIER LEAF GROWERS' COOPERATIVE [italic]Colony grown tobacco, from colony growers, for colony people. Founded at Hope's Retreat in 2176. Owned by the people who grow it.[/italic]
## WHO WE ARE Fourteen hydroponics technicians on three colonies who were tired of paying freight on a packet of cigarettes. In 2176 we started growing a few plants in the corner of the Hope's Retreat hydroponics bay, in the space the lettuce did not need. The administration noticed. We filled out a form. Seven years later the co-op has forty two members on Hope's Retreat, Shepherds' Pride and Solaris Ridge, and our leaf is smoked from one end of the Outer Veil to the other.
## WHAT WE BELIEVE - Colony grown is better than freighted. Fresher, cheaper and nobody had to put it in hypersleep. - Every member gets one vote, whether they grow one tray or forty. - Food trays come first. The co-op never takes a tray the colony needs to eat. - Profits go back to the growers, and a tenth goes to the colony clinic.
## THIS SEASON - [bold]A good harvest.[/bold] The spring cut at Hope's Retreat came in heavy and green. Cured leaf will be ready for the store by the next freighter. - [bold]New members welcome.[/bold] Any hydroponics technician on a colony with spare tray capacity can apply. See the growers page. - [bold]A word to Koorlander.[/bold] Our friends at Koorlander have once again offered to buy the co-op. We have once again said no, thank you. We still stock their packets, because our members smoke them.

[color=#7A6A4A]Tobacco is for adults. It will shorten your life, and the co-op will not pretend otherwise. We would rather you bought from us than from a smuggler, and rather still that you did not need to buy at all.[/color]
